robust_cell: sharpe_IS > 0 and sharpe_VAL > 0 and PF_IS > 1 and PF_VAL > 1 and trade_count_IS >= 20 and trade_count_VAL >= 20
contiguity: orthogonal four-neighbor adjacency in grid-index space
plateau_exists: largest contiguous robust component contains at least 2 cells

atr_trend_flip.objective: Test whether a common IS/Validation plateau exists below multiplier 2.0.

gap_continuation.objective: Measure how far the edge persists beyond a 1.5 ATR minimum gap.
